$comment: Repo-portable Claude Code plugin config. Makes obra/Superpowers (MIT; no keys) available + enabled for anyone who opens this repo. Codex/Copilot install via their own plugin marketplace — see scripts/setup-agent-tools.sh and docs/agent-tooling.md. Opt out by setting enabledPlugins.superpowers... to false or removing this block. The SessionStart hook points core.hooksPath at .githooks when it is unset (what the root `prepare` script does on install, which an install without lifecycle scripts or a worktree sharing node_modules never runs), so commits in agent sessions meet the pre-commit gate; it writes the common git config so worktrees share it, never overrides an existing value, prints nothing and always exits 0. HOBO_SKIP_HOOKS=1 or CI skips it, as in scripts/install-hooks.mts.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && [ -z "${HOBO_SKIP_HOOKS:-}${CI:-}" ] && [ -d .githooks ] && ! git config --get core.hooksPath >/dev/null 2>&1 && common=$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$common" ] && git config --file "$common/config" core.hooksPath .githooks >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
